metadata.description: Official Pubky agent skills for AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini).

plugins.name: pubky
plugins.description: Build applications ON the Pubky protocol — web, server, and native mobile. Use for the Pubky client SDKs (@synonymdev/pubky JS/WASM, the pubky Rust crate, @synonymdev/react-native-pubky, pubky-core-ffi), keypair identity and the pubkyauth flow, pubky:// /pub storage (put/get/list/delete), spec-compliant data with pubky-app-specs, pkarr resolution, and querying the Nexus read API. Bundles the `pubky` (web/server) and `pubky-mobile` (iOS/Android/React Native) skills. NOT for running or self-hosting infrastructure — install the pubky-infra plugin for that.

plugins.name: pubky-infra
plugins.description: Operate and self-host Pubky infrastructure. Use for running a homeserver (Docker, admin API, config.toml, signup tokens), the Nexus indexer (nexusd, Neo4j/Redis, migrations), the full local stack (pubky-docker), signup gating (homegate), self-sovereign DNS (pkdns, pkarr-relay), and http-relay. NOT for building apps that consume Pubky — install the pubky plugin for that.
